# secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_destination_list_mappings (Resource)

This resource manages a ZTA Profile Internet Access Destination List Mappings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_destination_list_mappings" "example" {
  zta_profile_id = "acde070d-8c4c-4f0d-9d8a-162843c10333"
  destination_lists = [
    {
      id         = "54321"
      exclusions = ["www.example.com"]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_lists` (Attributes Set) List of destination lists mapped to the ZTNA Profile for internet access steering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_lists))
- `zta_profile_id` (String) ID of the ZTNA Profile. Mappings are relevant only when `internet_access_steering_mode` of the profile is `2` (by list).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the internet access destination list mappings, incremented on each change.

<a id="nestedatt--destination_lists"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_lists`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the destination list.

Optional:

- `exclusions` (Set of String) Exclusions from all destinations of the destination list. FQDN, wildcard FQDN, IPv4 address and CIDR are allowed. An FQDN must be a sub-domain, and a CIDR a subnet, of one of the destinations of the destination list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_zta_profile_internet_access_destination_list_mappings.example "<zta_profile_id>,<id>"
```
